items.title: Commission approves French State aid to support offshore wind energy
items.description: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Jul 2026 The European Commission has approved a €63 billion French scheme to support offshore wind energy in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy. The scheme was approved under the Clean Industrial Deal State Aid Framework (CISAF) adopted by the Commission on 25 June 2025.

items.description: Ukraine's allies are meeting in Paris for talks on continued military support for Kyiv. Meanwhile the EU's top diplomat said there's no consensus yet on more Russian sanctions. DW has more.

items.title: EU experts urge social media restrictions for kids under 13
items.description: An expert panel has recommended limiting access to social media for young children across the EU. The European Commission is expected to present a proposal for legislation on the issue in the coming months.

items.title: EU approves new passenger rights for air travel
items.description: EU ministers have approved a set of reforms giving more rights to air travelers. Among other things, compensation claims are to be made easier.
